outline: 1. Economic Dispatch 2. Transmission System Effects 3. Unit Commitment 4. Hydrothermal Coordination 5. Control of Generation
schedule:
Week1:Introduction
Week2~3:Characteristics of Power Generation Units
Week4~6:Economic Dispatch of Thermal Units and Methods of Solution vs.
A. Optimization within constraints
B. Dynamic Programming
Week7~8:Transmission System Effects
Week9:Examination
Week10~11:Unit Commitment
vs. Dual Optimization on a Nonconvex problem
Week12~13:Generation with Limited Energy Supply vs. Linear Programming
Week14~15:Hydrothermal Coordination
vs. Hydro-scheduling with storage limitations
Week16~17 Production Cost Models
vs. Probability Methods and Users in Generation Planning
Week18:Control of Generation
